question: Does the two-slot mixture retain the previously seen B rule better than a single memory without a large stationary-stream penalty?
hypothesis: Two fixed memory slots with unlabeled posterior routing retain B after A returns, while remaining close to the single model on stationary streams.
falsification: The paired B-probe gain is below 0.10, fewer than 60 percent of seeds improve, or stationary online accuracy falls more than two percentage points.
